name: Klardaten (DATEV)
description: Klardaten API over a tax advisory firm's DATEV system: client master data, income, corporate and trade tax returns, bookkeeping (postings, SuSa, bank transactions), LODAS payroll, practice management analytics and a read-only DATEVconnect passthrough.
prerequisites: The Klardaten connector installed on the firm's DATEV server and a DATEV instance in the Klardaten dashboard. Tax and payroll data of the firm's clients: put this connector only on servers whose users may see all of it.
instructions:
**Sensitive data: read this first.** This connector reads a tax advisory firm's DATEV data through Klardaten: the master data, tax returns, bookkeeping and payroll of the firm's clients, including salaries, tax numbers, birth dates and bank transactions of private persons and companies. That data is covered by professional secrecy (§ 203 StGB, § 57 StBerG) and the GDPR. Add this connector only to servers whose users are allowed to see all of it, for example the partners or the staff who already have that access in DATEV. Do not add it to a shared or company-wide server. The API key acts with the DATEV profile behind it, so a model sees whatever that profile can read.

**Setup**
1. Sign in at https://dashboard.klardaten.com and create an API key for your user. It starts with `uk-` and goes into `KLARDATEN_API_KEY`; it is sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.
2. Copy the id of the DATEV instance (a UUID, created with your consultant number when the Klardaten connector was installed on the DATEV server) into `KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID`. Every DATEV request carries it in the `x-client-instance-id` header. `klardaten_list_instances` lists the instances the key can reach.
3. The Klardaten connector on the DATEV server must be running. When it is offline, DATEV calls fail while `klardaten_get_me` still works; `klardaten_get_datevconnect_health` shows the service status.

**Which tool to start with**: `klardaten_get_me` to check access, then `klardaten_list_clients` (master data), `klardaten_list_accounting_clients` (bookkeeping), `klardaten_list_payroll_clients` (LODAS payroll) or `klardaten_list_firm_clients` (the firm's own practice management analytics).

**Ids differ per area.** Master data uses UUIDs (`client_id`, `addressee_id`). Accounting uses a numeric `client_id` from `klardaten_list_accounting_clients`, and fiscal years are keyed by their start date as `YYYYMMDD` (e.g. `20250101`). Payroll and firm analytics use the `client_number`. Tax returns have their own `id`. Passing an id from another area is the usual cause of a 400 or 404.

**Paging, fields and filters**: list tools take `page` (from 1) and `page_size` (default 100), `order_by` (`field:asc|desc`, comma-separated), `fields` (comma-separated, keeps answers small) and `filter`. A filter is `field operator value` with `eq`, `like`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in`, `notin`, `is`, `isnot`, combined with `AND`/`OR`, e.g. `client_id eq 101 AND fiscal_year eq 20250101`. Only the fields of that endpoint are accepted; an unknown field or a wrongly formatted value returns 400. Always filter `klardaten_list_postings` by `client_id` and `fiscal_year`: across all clients of a firm the query takes about a minute and can time out.

**DATEVconnect passthrough**: `klardaten_datevconnect_get` reads any DATEVconnect GET path (e.g. `master-data/v1/clients`) for data the other tools do not cover. It is read-only.

**Licensing**: the Enterprise endpoints (accounting, payroll, tax, analytics) depend on the Klardaten plan; an endpoint outside the plan answers 403. `klardaten_search_documents` needs the document search add-on, which Klardaten enables per instance on request; it is installed switched off, turn it on once the add-on is active.

KLARDATEN_API_KEY.label: API key
KLARDATEN_API_KEY.help: Klardaten dashboard → your user → API keys → create key. It starts with uk-. The key reads DATEV with your user's default profile.
KLARDATEN_API_KEY.patternMessage: A Klardaten API key starts with uk-.

KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID.label: DATEV instance id
KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID.help: The id of your DATEV instance in the Klardaten dashboard (a UUID). It is also returned by the instance list of the Klardaten API.
KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID.patternMessage: The instance id is a UUID, e.g. 48fa2446-c731-4a74-9ea7-b4bd6d66fe5f.

verifyHints.401: Klardaten refused the API key. Create a new key in the Klardaten dashboard and paste it whole, starting with uk-.
verifyHints.403: The key works but may not read this DATEV instance or this data area. Check that your user is assigned to the instance and that the plan includes the Enterprise API.
verifyHints.bad_request: Klardaten rejected the request. Check that the instance id is the UUID of your DATEV instance.
verifyHints.unreachable: The DATEV server did not answer through Klardaten. Check that the Klardaten connector and DATEVconnect are running on the DATEV server.

tools.name: klardaten_get_me
tools.description: Return the user the API key belongs to and the effective access for the configured DATEV instance. Use it first to check that the key and instance id work.

tools.name: klardaten_list_instances
tools.description: List the DATEV instances (client instances) the account can reach, with id, name and consultant number. Use it to find the instance id for KLARDATEN_INSTANCE_ID.

unassigned.description: Include instances not assigned to the current user. Defaults to false.

include_deleted.description: Include deleted instances. Defaults to false.

tools.name: klardaten_list_clients
tools.description: List the advisory firm's DATEV clients (Mandanten) from master data: client_id, client_number, name, type, status, addresses, tax numbers and assignments. Start here to get a client_id or client_number.

order_by.description: Sort order as field:direction pairs, comma-separated, e.g. updated_at:desc,client_number:asc.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, e.g. client_id,client_number,client_name. Leave empty for all fields; narrowing keeps answers small.

filter.description: Filter expression 'field operator value'. Operators: eq, like, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, notin, is, isnot. Combine with AND / OR and parentheses, e.g. client_status eq 1 AND client_name like Müller. Useful fields: client_number, client_name, client_status, client_type, updated_at.

filter.description: Filter expression 'field operator value'. Operators: eq, like, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, notin, is, isnot. Combine with AND / OR and parentheses, e.g. client_status eq 1 AND client_name like Müller. Useful fields: client_number, invoice_year, invoice_date, invoice_number.

tools.name: klardaten_list_firm_capacity_planning
tools.description: Firm analytics: list monthly capacity per employee: total, planned, free, overtime and non-plannable capacity.

order_by.description: Sort order as field:direction pairs, comma-separated, e.g. updated_at:desc,client_number:asc.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return, e.g. client_id,client_number,client_name. Leave empty for all fields; narrowing keeps answers small.

filter.description: Filter expression 'field operator value'. Operators: eq, like, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, notin, is, isnot. Combine with AND / OR and parentheses, e.g. client_status eq 1 AND client_name like Müller. Useful fields: calendar_year, calendar_month, employee_number.

tools.name: klardaten_get_firm_order_categories
tools.description: Firm analytics: return revenue, costs and contribution margins by order group for one client, for the latest fully invoiced year of each group.

apply_ja_exception.description: Apply the annual financial statement (JA) exception to the named order group and type.

order_group_name.description: Order group the JA exception applies to.

order_type_name.description: Order type the JA exception applies to.

tools.name: klardaten_get_datevconnect_health
tools.description: Return the latest service status changes of DATEVconnect on the configured instance (up to 100, last 30 days). Use it when DATEV calls fail or time out.

from_date.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Data is kept for 30 days.

tools.name: klardaten_get_usage_stats
tools.description: Return API usage of the configured instance in time bins: request count and average response time per status class.

from_date.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Data is kept for 30 days.

granularity_minutes.description: Bin size in minutes, at least 1.

tools.name: klardaten_datevconnect_get
tools.description: Read any DATEVconnect endpoint through the Klardaten gateway (GET only), for data the other tools do not cover, e.g. master-data/v1/clients or accounting/v1/clients. Returns DATEV's own JSON.

path.description: DATEVconnect path without a leading slash, e.g. master-data/v1/clients or hr/v1/clients. See DATEV's DATEVconnect API documentation for the paths.

query.description: Optional query string without the leading ?, e.g. top=50&skip=0. Passed through to DATEVconnect unchanged.

tools.name: klardaten_search_documents
tools.description: Search the indexed DATEV DMS documents with a natural-language query in German or English and return the best matches with snippets. Needs Klardaten's document search add-on; installed switched off.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. Rechnung 471102 Lieferant GmbH.

top_k.description: Number of documents to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 5.

include_chunks.description: Include the matched text passages. Defaults to false.

filters.description: Optional metadata filters, e.g. {"client_id": "..."}. Keys: client_id, dms_document_number, folder_id, register_id, extension, filename.
